sys_app.name: CMDB Health Validator for AI Readiness
sys_app.description: Audits CMDB data quality for AI/automation readiness. Produces AI Readiness Score (0-100) across completeness, staleness, relationship integrity, duplicate detection, and class coverage dimensions. Generates prioritized remediation plans with Now Assist integration.

role.name: x_snc_cah.admin
role.description: Full access to CMDB Health Validator configuration and administration

role.name: x_snc_cah.user
role.description: Read access to health scans and remediation tasks; can execute REST API

table.name: cmdb_ci
table.description: Read CI records for health scanning

table.name: cmdb_rel_ci
table.description: Read CI relationships for integrity scanning

table.name: sys_db_object
table.description: Read CI class definitions for coverage analysis

table.name: sys_dictionary
table.description: Read field definitions for completeness analysis
